name: 1/7 G.S. Collection [SC] Hatsune Miku Symphony: 10th Anniversary Ver.
description: Celebrate the 10th anniversary of the Hatsune Miku Symphony with this gorgeous new G.S. Collection [SC] (Signature Class)] figure from Good Smile Company! Our girl Miku dances in front of a grand column with her arms spread wide, while golden ribbons bedecked with stars swirl around her! Her extravagantly ruffled skirt and sleeves are carefully sculpted, with even more ruffles at the cuffs of her stockings; a golden ornament atop the column signifies the 10th anniversary. Miku's hair is especially wonderful, flowing softly around and behind her, made of partially painted clear material for a light and airy feel. There's so much detail in this figure, it's almost dizzying -- the delicate white doves holding the ribbons, Miku's crown and the golden roses she wears in her hair, her shining eyes and big smile! This figure will be the centerpiece of your collection -- place your order today! [Figure Size]: Approximately 37cm tall

description: Hatsune Miku gets a new figure from Good Smile Company, based on the theme of Han Gong Qiu Yue, and inspired by an illustration by the artist Rella! This figure brings the elegant yet slightly sorrowful version of Miku straight into your collection; she's seated in a round window, holding a traditional Chinese instrument known as an erhu. description: The beloved virtual singer Hatsune Miku joins Bandai's Metal Build series!&nbsp;Building upon the alloy action figure design expertise honed within the Metal Build series, this figure features composite materials -- such as fabric costume pieces and twin-tails crafted from wire-embedded PVC sheets -- along with design arrangements that accentuate its metallic nature, and exquisite coloring that further highlights its aesthetic appeal. An interchangeable smiling face with the eyes looking right is included; when combined with poses that take full advantage of the figure's exceptional articulation, this allows for the creation of a spirited, confident expression. An additional interchangeable face with a shouting expression, with the eyes looking left, is included too. Pair it with her acoustic gadgets to capture the high-energy atmosphere of a live concert performance!&nbsp;She also comes with a singing expression with her eyes closed; combined with her flexibly articulated PVC twin tails, it creates a scene as if a specific moment of her performance has been captured in time.&nbsp;You can extend specific sections of her heels to expand the ground contact area to enhance stability during action poses.&nbsp;The main body features a design arrangement refined through Metal Build technology. The strategic use of alloy joints with a metallic sheen throughout the figure highlights its unique appeal as the first-ever female character to join the Metal Build series!The figure's back features a mechanical design optimized for articulation, ensuring that even poses involving a deep backward arch of the torso look stunningly natural and precise.&nbsp;Thanks to hip joints constructed with multiple axes of rotation, the figure allows for extensive forward and backward bending movements centered around the waist.A dedicated display stand featuring holographic foil accents is included.&nbsp;The Metal Build Hatsune Miku is the culmination of a creative chain forged by a diverse array of creators -- order her for your own collection today! [Figure Size]: Approximately 18cm tall [Materials]: ABS, die-cast, PVC, fabric [Set Contents]:Main figureInterchangeable faces (x4)Interchangeable hands (x4 each, left and right)Interchangeable front hair part with headdressInterchangeable twin-tail parts (left and right)Sound gadgetComplete fabric outfit setBackpack ABackpack BRight hand armorDisplay stand set

name: 1/4 Hatsune Miku -Japanese Doll-
description: Note: Due to the high value of this item, pre-payment is required upon placing your order, and cancellations will not be accepted.FuRyu's lovely Hatsune Miku dressed in traditional Japanese clothing will captivate your heart!Miku is the 9th figure in the F:NEX Nihon Ningyou Figure lineup, and is based on a new illustration by artist Fuji Choko.The word Hatsune in Japanese culture originally refers to the sound of birds and insects, especially bush warblers, singing for the first time in the year, and we have carefully expressed the profoundness of the name in this figure.For the kimono, which is a distinctive feature of this product, the fabric for the furisode portion was repeatedly tested so that the patterns would connect to each other even across the sewing line, and gold foil stamping was applied to reproduce a glittering gold sheen.These kimonos are dyed using the traditional yuzen-dyeing technique, using molds to carefully dye one color at a time. 12 colors are used for the green kimono and 11 colors for the blue kimono, and the time and effort put into the dyeing process gives them a unique depth of color.The facial expression is faithfully reproduced from the illustrations, with jewel-like eyes that catch the light and emit a variety of sparkles, and cheeks with a hint of vermilion and cherry-red lips to create a peaceful impression.Now can have this beautiful Hatsune Miku in your hands, a figure that has been carefully crafted with all the care and attention to detail that Japanese culture and traditions demand.Product Size: 1/4 scaleHeight: approx. 410mm (excluding pedestal)Material: PVC, ABS, rayon, polyester, acetate, cardboardCostume/Dress: YoshinoriSculptor: Design COCO (Art Director:CHIGA)Color creation: B_SachiDue to the convenience of the fabric and the method of dressing, there may be individual differences in the appearance of the patterns and wrinkles on the costumes.
